walkthrough: Goal: the kinds whose answer is built from given parts, a value scale, a box to complete, free boxes and an ellipse, practised in one frame, the one I draw in; what the exercise gives printed in it in a grey I cannot take for my own ink or pencil; and Compare showing the answer laid over my drawing and only what is off, the way to see it (看画法) one tap away (the author, 2026-10-30: the original's frame only repeated the question, a box's Compare was cluttered with every stroke drawn on dashed, an edge drawn twice drawn on twice, and a value scale's How fitted 5 cells while the row had up to 7).

Entry (S101: the test crops imported first, so a combination copies a crop): the Today card's options start Stage 2 · Single shapes. Without a pack of shapes its first session holds a colour combination, a value scale, a box and an ellipse. I pass the combination with Next.

Value scale, my first: five cells (a beginner's first two scales are five, then nine), the dark and light ends filled as given in the one frame; the frame beside it, where the original lay, is empty. Its How shows by itself, its example as many cells as my row (S97's review: a five-cell row read against a nine-cell example's 'the 5th' confused the author): five cells in other colours than mine, its order numbered 2 1 2 under its inner cells, the middle cell painted first, then each half's middle, each round its step lit; then Compare's marks: the even row under the copy's, cell under cell, one uneven cell outlined red with its even one. Steps: the middle cell first (the 3rd), then the middle of each half (the 2nd and 4th); Compare.

I pick values on the wheel moving only up and down and tap Fill cell three times: the cells fill one after another. Compare: under my row the even scale, cell under cell; the middle cell, too dark, outlined red together with its even one; the card its title and '1 cell uneven.' (no bars any more). Compare again takes it away; a lighter value, the pen touching the middle cell (S100: it takes it in hand and paints nothing, a scale has no pens) and Fill cell, Compare: every cell even, the card its title alone.

Box: one frame, the horizon labelled and the front corner with its three edges printed in slate grey; the original's slot empty. Its How by itself: ghost each edge, draw it once, a wrong one redrawn once with Correct, never scratched over; its example's Compare the red box with its hidden edges dashed, its points ringed, the one edge drawn off run on dashed red past its point. I sketch a construction line, draw the nine edges with Draw (one bottom edge a little off) and redraw another a few pixels and a degree off it, as a hand does.

Compare: the exact box red over mine, see-through and as thick as the pen, its hidden edges dashed; its two vanishing points ringed red on the sheet beside the frame, one in the empty slot; my correct edges get no marks at all, the redrawn edge one edge with them; only the edge drawn off is run on dashed red past its point's ring, missing it by what it is off. The card: 'Box 1', '1 edge misses its vanishing point.' and Construction. Construction tapped: faint grey lines from every corner of the red box to both points and the horizon run on across the sheet, the word in the ink pill; tapped again: gone. The correcting pen redraws the off edge (the comparison goes as it lands); Compare: 'Every edge heads for its vanishing point.', no dashes, Construction off again.

Ellipse: its frame printed grey in the one frame. I draw it narrow. Compare: the exact ellipse red, no fitted ellipse; small red rings only on the sides' middles mine falls short of; the card as before ('Yours is flatter; it falls short of the right side and the left side.') and Construction: the frame's diagonals and middle lines faint, the four middles dotted; tapped again, gone.

Finish: the summary. One more: the second session warms up with what I compared (a box, an ellipse, a five-cell scale: my second), then the colour work: a value scale of nine cells now, of a hue. How, tapped: its example nine cells too, numbered 3 2 3 1 3 2 3, steps the middle cell (the 5th), the middle of each half (the 3rd and 7th), the cells left (the 2nd, 4th, 6th and 8th), Compare; Got it. I touch its middle cell, then the 3rd and the 7th, with the pen and fill each with Fill cell (S100), my values picked carelessly; Compare: the nine-cell even row under mine, my three cells each outlined red with its even one, '3 cells uneven.', the cells I left bare nothing. Then free boxes: the horizon alone printed in the frame, no example box. I draw three boxes, one edge turned off and one box with a narrow front corner.

Compare: where each box's directions meet on the horizon ringed red, the turned edge run on dashed red past its point, the narrow corner's red arc; the other edges nothing; the card '1 edge misses its vanishing point; 1 front corner under 90°.' and Construction: every edge run on faint to where its direction meets, the horizon across the sheet; tapped again, gone. Finish: the summary.
In Chinese (this file, s97-one-frame run as on a Chinese tablet): 看画法, '1 格不均匀。', '1 条边没对准消失点。', the How cards' new words; the steps and the canvas's hashes are s97-one-frame's.

Not here: stage 3's tricks and solids and stage 4's objects (S98); a sheet made before 1.15.0 reopened (the store's upgrade, its scale kept by its seed: `store/src/practice_tests.rs`); the author's hand on the tablet.
